The filing comes only one week after Todd Blanche was confirmed by the Senate as U.S. Attorney General and after Blanche issued a memo rescinding previous orders about the Anti Weaponization fund.

posts.text: President Trump‘s Kennedy Center board of trustees decided to once again put Trump‘s name on the front of the building, in addition to confirming a two-year closure that a federal judge had blocked in May. posts.text: Attorney General Todd Blanche’s DOJ issued an advisory memo that broadens how executive privilege should be applied. Under the new interpretation, Trump could invoke executive privilege and refuse to share with courts and Congress communications with private advisors, who don’t work for the federal government. This would make accountability and scrutiny of executive actions more difficult.
posts.summary: Questions broad executive privilege expansion under Trump DOJ
